title: HP TET TGT Arts · November 2021 (previous year questions)
description: Questions asked in the HP TET TGT (Arts) exam held on 13 November 2021 (published in Hindi; shown here in English and Hindi), with answers checked against a published solved paper and independently verified. Not the complete paper.

questions.text: One reason for the low IQ of orphan children is:
questions.textHi: अनाथ बच्चों की कम बुद्धि-लब्धि का एक कारण है-
questions.explanation: Low IQ among orphans is attributed to a deprived environment lacking stimulation. (Q2 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: अनाथ बच्चों की कम बुद्धि-लब्धि का कारण उद्दीपन-रहित वंचित वातावरण माना जाता है।

questions.text: According to Spearman, the two factors of intelligence are:
questions.textHi: स्पीयरमैन के अनुसार बुद्धि के दो कारक हैं-
questions.explanation: Spearman's two-factor theory: general (g) and specific (s) factors. (Q3 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: स्पीयरमैन का द्वि-कारक सिद्धान्त: सामान्य (g) और विशिष्ट (s) कारक।

questions.text: The theory of seven Primary Mental Abilities of intelligence was proposed by:
questions.textHi: बुद्धि के सात प्राथमिक मानसिक योग्यताओं के सिद्धान्त के प्रतिपादक हैं-
questions.explanation: L.L. Thurstone proposed seven Primary Mental Abilities. (Q4 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: एल.एल. थर्स्टन ने सात प्राथमिक मानसिक योग्यताओं का सिद्धान्त दिया।

questions.text: According to Gardner, intelligence is ________ dimensional.
questions.textHi: गार्डनर के अनुसार, बुद्धि ________ आयामी है।
questions.explanation: Gardner's theory of multiple intelligences treats intelligence as multi-dimensional. (Q5 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: गार्डनर के बहु-बुद्धि सिद्धान्त के अनुसार बुद्धि बहु-आयामी है।

questions.text: According to Erikson, the developmental task for adolescents is:
questions.textHi: एरिकसन के अनुसार किशोरों के लिए विकासात्मक कार्य है-
questions.explanation: Erikson's adolescent stage is Identity vs Role Confusion. (Q7 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: एरिकसन के अनुसार किशोरावस्था की अवस्था 'पहचान बनाम भूमिका भ्रम' है।

questions.text: The level of Kohlberg's moral development based on punishment and reward is:
questions.textHi: दंड व पुरस्कार पर आधारित कोहलबर्ग के नैतिक विकास का स्तर है-
questions.explanation: Kohlberg's pre-conventional level: morality judged by punishment and reward. (Q8 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: कोहलबर्ग के पूर्व-पारम्परिक स्तर पर नैतिकता दंड और पुरस्कार से आँकी जाती है।

questions.text: The author of "The Interpretation of Dreams" is:
questions.textHi: "The Interpretation of Dreams" के लेखक हैं-
questions.explanation: Sigmund Freud published The Interpretation of Dreams in 1899/1900. (Q9 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: सिगमंड फ्रायड ने 1899/1900 में 'The Interpretation of Dreams' प्रकाशित की।

questions.text: Humanism lays emphasis on:
questions.textHi: मानवतावाद बल देता है-
questions.explanation: Humanistic psychology (Rogers, Maslow) emphasises the self. (Q10 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: मानवतावादी मनोविज्ञान (रोजर्स, मैस्लो) 'स्व' पर बल देता है।

questions.text: Information processing is held to be the basis for explaining behaviour in:
questions.textHi: व्यवहार की व्याख्या में सूचना प्रक्रमण को आधार बताया गया है-
questions.explanation: Information processing is the core model of cognitivism. (Q11 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: सूचना प्रक्रमण संज्ञानात्मकवाद का मूल प्रतिमान है।

questions.text: At the centre of the teaching-learning process is the ________.
questions.textHi: अधिगम-शिक्षण प्रक्रिया के केंद्र में ________ है।
questions.explanation: In learner-centred education, the learner is at the centre of the teaching-learning process. (Q12 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: अधिगमकर्ता-केन्द्रित शिक्षा में अधिगम-शिक्षण प्रक्रिया के केन्द्र में अधिगमकर्ता होता है।

questions.text: According to psychoanalysis, the origin of behaviour lies in:
questions.textHi: मनोविश्लेषणवाद के अनुसार, व्यवहार की उत्पत्ति का आधार है-
questions.explanation: Freudian psychoanalysis traces behaviour to unconscious drives. (Q13 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: फ्रायड का मनोविश्लेषणवाद व्यवहार का मूल अचेतन प्रवृत्तियों में मानता है।

questions.text: The main gland affecting the process of development is the:
questions.textHi: विकास प्रक्रिया को प्रभावित करने वाली प्रमुख ग्रन्थि है-
questions.explanation: The pituitary is the master gland and secretes growth hormone. (Q14 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: पीयूष ग्रन्थि 'मास्टर ग्रन्थि' है और वृद्धि हार्मोन स्रावित करती है।

questions.text: In Pavlov's classical conditioning experiment, the sound of the bell is the:
questions.textHi: पावलॉव के प्राचीन अनुबन्धन प्रयोग में घण्टी की आवाज है-
questions.explanation: In Pavlov's experiment the bell becomes the conditioned stimulus (food is the unconditioned stimulus). (Q15 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: पावलॉव के प्रयोग में घण्टी अनुबन्धित उद्दीपक बन जाती है (भोजन अननुबन्धित उद्दीपक है)।

questions.text: Identity formation takes place in:
questions.textHi: पहचान निर्माण किया जाता है-
questions.explanation: Identity formation is the central task of adolescence (Erikson). (Q17 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: एरिकसन के अनुसार पहचान निर्माण किशोरावस्था का केन्द्रीय कार्य है।

questions.text: At the pre-conventional stage, morality is determined on the basis of ________.
questions.textHi: पूर्व-पारम्परिक अवस्था में नैतिकता का निर्धारण ________ के आधार पर किया जाता है।
questions.explanation: Kohlberg's pre-conventional level: right and wrong judged by punishment and reward. (Q18 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: कोहलबर्ग के पूर्व-पारम्परिक स्तर पर सही-गलत का निर्णय दंड और पुरस्कार से होता है।

questions.text: ________ constructed the 16PF personality questionnaire.
questions.textHi: ________ ने व्यक्तित्व की 16PF प्रश्नावली का निर्माण किया है।
questions.explanation: R.B. Cattell developed the Sixteen Personality Factor (16PF) questionnaire. (Q19 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: आर.बी. कैटेल ने सोलह व्यक्तित्व कारक (16PF) प्रश्नावली बनाई।

questions.text: A stable, learned evaluation in a positive or negative form is:
questions.textHi: सकारात्मक व नकारात्मक रूप में स्थायी व अधिगमित मूल्यांकन है-
questions.explanation: An attitude is a learned, relatively stable positive or negative evaluation. (Q20 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: अभिवृत्ति एक अर्जित, अपेक्षाकृत स्थायी सकारात्मक या नकारात्मक मूल्यांकन है।

questions.text: Conditions that increase or decrease the attractiveness of a goal are:
questions.textHi: किसी लक्ष्य के आकर्षण को बढ़ाने या घटाने वाली स्थितियाँ हैं-
questions.explanation: Incentives are external conditions that change the attractiveness of a goal. (Q21 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: प्रलोभन वे बाहरी स्थितियाँ हैं जो किसी लक्ष्य के आकर्षण को बढ़ाती या घटाती हैं।

questions.text: A relatively permanent change in behaviour is:
questions.textHi: व्यवहार में अपेक्षाकृत स्थायी परिवर्तन है-
questions.explanation: Learning is a relatively permanent change in behaviour resulting from experience. (Q22 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: अनुभव से व्यवहार में होने वाला अपेक्षाकृत स्थायी परिवर्तन अधिगम है।

questions.text: The potential to do well in a particular field through training is:
questions.textHi: प्रशिक्षण के द्वारा किसी क्षेत्र विशेष में अच्छा कर पाने की सम्भावना है-
questions.explanation: Aptitude is the potential to acquire skill in a field with training. (Q23 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: प्रशिक्षण द्वारा किसी क्षेत्र में कौशल अर्जित करने की सम्भावना अभिक्षमता है।

questions.text: In Maslow's theory, the first-level needs are:
questions.textHi: मैस्लो के सिद्धान्त में प्रथम स्तर की आवश्यकताएँ हैं-
questions.explanation: The base of Maslow's hierarchy is physiological (biological) needs. (Q24 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: मैस्लो के पदानुक्रम का आधार दैहिक (जैविक) आवश्यकताएँ हैं।

questions.text: The use of negative reinforcement by the teacher will ________ the probability of the student's correct pronunciation.
questions.textHi: अध्यापक द्वारा ऋणात्मक पुनर्बलक का प्रयोग विद्यार्थी के शुद्ध उच्चारण की सम्भावना को ________।
questions.explanation: All reinforcement, positive or negative, increases the probability of the behaviour. (Q25 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: पुनर्बलन, चाहे धनात्मक हो या ऋणात्मक, व्यवहार की सम्भावना को बढ़ाता है।

questions.text: "Intelligence is the aggregate or global capacity of the individual to act purposefully, to think rationally and to deal effectively with his environment." Whose statement is this?
questions.textHi: "बुद्धि व्यक्ति की वह समग्र क्षमता है जिसके द्वारा व्यक्ति सविवेक चिंतन करने, सोद्देश्य व्यवहार करने तथा अपने पर्यावरण से प्रभावी रूप से निपटने में समर्थ होता है।" यह कथन किसका है?
questions.explanation: This is David Wechsler's definition of intelligence. (Q26 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: यह डेविड वेक्सलर द्वारा दी गई बुद्धि की परिभाषा है।

questions.text: The intelligence related to understanding the behaviour of other people is:
questions.textHi: दूसरे व्यक्तियों के व्यवहारों को समझने से सम्बन्धित बुद्धि है-
questions.explanation: Gardner's interpersonal intelligence concerns understanding others. (Q27 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: गार्डनर की अन्तरवैयक्तिक बुद्धि दूसरों को समझने से सम्बन्धित है।

questions.text: The mental age of an 8-year-old child whose IQ is 75 will be:
questions.textHi: 8 वर्षीय बालक जिसकी बुद्धि-लब्धि 75 है, की मानसिक आयु होगी-
questions.explanation: IQ = MA/CA x 100, so MA = 75 x 8 / 100 = 6 years. (Q28 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: बुद्धि-लब्धि = मानसिक आयु/वास्तविक आयु x 100, अतः मानसिक आयु = 75 x 8 / 100 = 6 वर्ष।

questions.text: Meaningful sensation is:
questions.textHi: अर्थपूर्ण संवेदना है-
questions.explanation: Perception is sensation given meaning. (Q29 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: संवेदना को अर्थ मिलने पर वह प्रत्यक्षीकरण कहलाती है।

questions.text: A child's information-processing capacity is ________.
questions.textHi: बालक की सूचना प्रक्रमण क्षमता ________ है।
questions.explanation: Working memory / information-processing capacity is limited. (Q30 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: कार्यकारी स्मृति / सूचना प्रक्रमण क्षमता सीमित होती है।

questions.text: Choose the correct form of indirect speech: He said to him, "Please wait here till I return."
options: He asked him to wait here till I returned.
He told him to wait there till I returned.
He requested him to wait there till he returned.
He ordered him to wait there till I returned.
questions.explanation: 'Please' becomes 'requested'; 'here' becomes 'there'; 'I return' becomes 'he returned'. (Q31 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html

questions.text: Choose the correct form of indirect speech: Rama said to Arjun, "Go away."
options: Rama shouted at Arjun to go away.
Rama ordered Arjun that he should go away.
Rama said to Arjun that he could go away.
Rama ordered Arjun to go away.
questions.explanation: An imperative command is reported with ordered + object + to-infinitive. (Q33 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html

questions.text: Choose the correct form of indirect speech: He said, "I saw this man long ago."
options: He said that I had seen this man long ago.
He said that he had seen that man long before.
He said that he has seen that man long before.
He said that he had saw that man long ago.
questions.explanation: Simple past becomes past perfect; 'this' becomes 'that'; 'ago' becomes 'before'. (Q34 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html

questions.text: Give one word for: Life history of a man written by himself
questions.explanation: An autobiography is written by the subject; a biography by someone else. (Q37 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html

questions.text: Give one word for: Lover of mankind
questions.explanation: A philanthropist loves and helps mankind. (Q38 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html

questions.text: The correct masculine gender for 'VIXEN' is:
questions.explanation: A vixen is a female fox. (Q39 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html

questions.text: The masculine gender for 'DUCK' is:
questions.explanation: A male duck is a drake. (Q40 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html

questions.text: Choose the correct preposition: I prefer tea ____ coffee.
questions.explanation: 'Prefer' takes 'to' (prefer X to Y), not 'than'. (Q43 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html

questions.text: Complete the idiom: As blind as a ____
questions.explanation: Fixed simile: 'as blind as a bat'. (Q45 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html

questions.text: Complete the idiom: As faithful as a ____
questions.explanation: Fixed simile: 'as faithful as a dog'. (Q46 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html

questions.text: Complete the idiom: As cunning as a ____
questions.explanation: Fixed simile: 'as cunning as a fox'. (Q47 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html

questions.text: Complete the idiom: As gentle as a ____
questions.explanation: Fixed simile: 'as gentle as a lamb'. (Q48 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html

questions.text: Choose the correct synonym of 'MUSTER':
questions.explanation: To muster is to assemble or collect. (Q49 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html

questions.text: Choose the correct synonym of 'APATHY':
questions.explanation: Apathy means lack of interest or concern - indifference. (Q50 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html

questions.text: Choose the correct synonym of 'SHOVE':
questions.explanation: To shove is to push roughly. (Q51 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html

questions.text: Choose the correct synonym of 'STAGNANT':
questions.explanation: Stagnant means not flowing or moving - stationary. (Q52 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html

questions.text: Choose the correct conjunction: Be just ____ fear not.
questions.explanation: The well-known line is 'Be just and fear not' (Shakespeare, Henry VIII). (Q53 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html

questions.text: Choose the correct conjunction: Do not go ____ I come.
questions.explanation: 'Till' marks the point in time up to which the action should not happen. (Q54 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html

questions.text: Choose the correct conjunction: I have been in such a pickle ____ I saw you last.
questions.explanation: Present perfect + 'since' + point in past ('since I saw you last'). (Q55 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html

questions.text: Choose the correct conjunction: I have never seen him ____ the unfortunate event happened.
questions.explanation: Present perfect + 'since' + past event. (Q56 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html

questions.text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to 'FOE':
questions.explanation: Foe means enemy; its opposite is friend. (Q57 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html

questions.text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to 'TIMID':
questions.explanation: Timid means shy/fearful; its opposite is bold. (Q58 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html

questions.text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to 'PROSPERITY':
questions.explanation: Prosperity (flourishing) is opposed by adversity (misfortune). (Q59 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html

questions.text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to 'MISER':

questions.text: Who founded the "Satyashodhak Samaj"?
questions.textHi: "सत्यशोधक समाज" किसने बनाया?
questions.explanation: Jyotiba Phule founded the Satyashodhak Samaj in 1873. (Q110 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: ज्योतिबा फुले ने 1873 में सत्यशोधक समाज की स्थापना की।

questions.text: The 'Sudirman Cup' is related to which sport?
questions.textHi: 'सुदीरमन कप' का सम्बन्ध किस खेल से है?
questions.explanation: The Sudirman Cup is the world mixed-team badminton championship. (Q111 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: सुदीरमन कप बैडमिंटन की विश्व मिश्रित टीम चैम्पियनशिप है।

questions.text: The newspaper 'Leader' is associated with which great freedom fighter?
questions.textHi: 'लीडर' समाचार पत्र का सम्बन्ध किस महान स्वतन्त्रता सेनानी से है?
questions.explanation: Madan Mohan Malaviya founded The Leader (Allahabad, 1909). (Q112 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: मदन मोहन मालवीय ने 1909 में इलाहाबाद से 'द लीडर' आरम्भ किया।

questions.text: Who is called the father of Indian 'local self-government'?
questions.textHi: भारतीय 'स्वशासन' का पितामह किसे कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: Lord Ripon's 1882 resolution earned him the title father of local self-government in India. (Q113 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: 1882 के प्रस्ताव के कारण लॉर्ड रिपन को भारत में स्थानीय स्वशासन का जनक कहा जाता है।

questions.text: Which is the second largest continent in the world by area?
questions.textHi: क्षेत्रफल के हिसाब से विश्व का दूसरा सबसे बड़ा महाद्वीप कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: Asia is largest, Africa second. (Q114 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: एशिया सबसे बड़ा और अफ्रीका दूसरा सबसे बड़ा महाद्वीप है।

questions.text: In which battle did Muhammad Ghori defeat Jaichand?
questions.textHi: मुहम्मद गोरी ने जयचन्द को किस युद्ध में पराजित किया था?
questions.explanation: Ghori defeated Jaichand of Kannauj at Chandawar in 1194. (Q115 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: गोरी ने 1194 में चंदावर के युद्ध में कन्नौज के जयचन्द को हराया।

questions.text: According to the Indian Constitution, who is the first citizen of the country?
questions.textHi: भारतीय संविधान के अनुसार देश का प्रथम नागरिक कौन होता है?
questions.explanation: The President is regarded as the first citizen of India. (Q116 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: राष्ट्रपति को भारत का प्रथम नागरिक माना जाता है।

questions.text: In which state is the famous 'Gangaur' festival held?
questions.textHi: प्रसिद्ध 'गणगौर' उत्सव किस राज्य में आयोजित किया जाता है?
questions.explanation: Gangaur is a major festival of Rajasthan. (Q117 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: गणगौर राजस्थान का प्रमुख त्योहार है।

questions.text: Which ruler built the Sanchi Stupa?
questions.textHi: साँची का स्तूप किस शासक ने बनवाया था?
questions.explanation: The Great Stupa at Sanchi was commissioned by Ashoka (3rd c. BCE). (Q118 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: साँची का महान स्तूप अशोक ने (तीसरी शताब्दी ई.पू. में) बनवाया।

questions.text: Who was the first woman president of the Indian National Congress?
questions.textHi: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय काँग्रेस की प्रथम महिला अध्यक्ष कौन थीं?
questions.explanation: Annie Besant presided over the 1917 Calcutta session; Sarojini Naidu (1925) was the first Indian woman president. (Q119 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: एनी बेसेंट ने 1917 के कलकत्ता अधिवेशन की अध्यक्षता की; सरोजिनी नायडू (1925) प्रथम भारतीय महिला अध्यक्ष थीं।

questions.text: Who first interpreted (deciphered) Ashoka's inscriptions?
questions.textHi: अशोक के शिलालेखों की सर्वप्रथम व्याख्या किसने की?
questions.explanation: James Prinsep deciphered the Brahmi script of Ashokan edicts in 1837. (Q120 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: जेम्स प्रिंसेप ने 1837 में अशोक के अभिलेखों की ब्राह्मी लिपि पढ़ी।

questions.text: When was Kangra district formed?
questions.textHi: कांगड़ा जिला कब बना था?
questions.explanation: Kangra district was reorganised into its present form on 1 September 1972 (Hamirpur and Una carved out). (Q121 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: 1 सितम्बर 1972 को कांगड़ा जिला वर्तमान स्वरूप में पुनर्गठित हुआ (हमीरपुर और ऊना अलग बने)।

questions.text: Which of the following rivers has the largest volume of water?
questions.textHi: निम्नलिखित में से किस नदी का आयतन सबसे अधिक है?
questions.explanation: The Chenab (Chandrabhaga) is the largest river of Himachal Pradesh by volume of water. (Q123 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: जल की मात्रा के हिसाब से चिनाब (चन्द्रभागा) हिमाचल प्रदेश की सबसे बड़ी नदी है।

questions.text: Which of the following districts produces the most ginger?
questions.textHi: निम्न में से किस जिले में अदरक का सर्वाधिक उत्पादन होता है?
questions.explanation: Sirmaur is the leading ginger-producing district of Himachal Pradesh. (Q126 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: सिरमौर हिमाचल प्रदेश का सबसे अधिक अदरक उत्पादक जिला है।

questions.text: Which of the following is known as the 'Architect of Himachal'?
questions.textHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन 'आर्किटेक्ट ऑफ हिमाचल' के नाम से जाना जाता है?
questions.explanation: Dr. Y.S. Parmar, first CM of HP, is called the Architect of Himachal. (Q132 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: हिमाचल के प्रथम मुख्यमंत्री डॉ. वाई.एस. परमार को 'हिमाचल निर्माता' कहा जाता है।

questions.text: When was Article 370 abrogated?
questions.textHi: धारा 370 को कब समाप्त किया गया?
questions.explanation: Article 370 was effectively abrogated on 5-6 August 2019. (Q134 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: अनुच्छेद 370 को 5-6 अगस्त 2019 को प्रभावी रूप से समाप्त किया गया।

questions.text: In which state did the Navnirman Andolan begin?
questions.textHi: नवनिर्माण आन्दोलन किस राज्य से शुरू हुआ था?
questions.explanation: The Nav Nirman Andolan of 1973-74 began in Gujarat. (Q135 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: 1973-74 का नवनिर्माण आन्दोलन गुजरात से शुरू हुआ।

questions.text: The politics of 'Aaya Ram Gaya Ram' started in:
questions.textHi: 'आया राम गया राम' की राजनीति शुरू हुई थी-
questions.explanation: The phrase arose from Haryana MLA Gaya Lal's repeated defections in 1967. (Q136 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: यह मुहावरा 1967 में हरियाणा के विधायक गया लाल के बार-बार दल-बदल से बना।

questions.text: When was the Babri Masjid structure in Ayodhya demolished?
questions.textHi: अयोध्या में बाबरी मस्जिद का ढांचा कब गिराया गया था?
questions.explanation: The structure was demolished on 6 December 1992. (Q138 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: यह ढांचा 6 दिसम्बर 1992 को गिराया गया।

questions.text: Which countries are known as the Third World?
questions.textHi: कौन से देश तीसरी दुनिया के नाम से जाने जाते हैं?
questions.explanation: 'Third World' denotes developing (non-aligned) countries. (Q139 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: 'तीसरी दुनिया' से आशय विकासशील (गुटनिरपेक्ष) देशों से है।

questions.text: Who was the founder of the "Bharatiya Jana Sangh"?
questions.textHi: "भारतीय जन संघ" के संस्थापक कौन थे?
questions.explanation: S.P. Mookerjee founded the Bharatiya Jana Sangh in 1951. (Q141 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: डॉ. श्यामा प्रसाद मुखर्जी ने 1951 में भारतीय जन संघ की स्थापना की।

questions.text: When did Operation 'Blue Star' take place?
questions.textHi: ऑपरेशन 'ब्लू स्टार' कब हुआ था?
questions.explanation: Operation Blue Star took place in June 1984. (Q143 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: ऑपरेशन ब्लू स्टार जून 1984 में हुआ।

questions.text: The 'Bodo problem' is related to which state?
questions.textHi: 'बोडो समस्या' किस राज्य से सम्बन्धित है?
questions.explanation: The Bodo issue concerns Assam. (Q144 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: बोडो समस्या असम से सम्बन्धित है।

questions.text: In which year was ASEAN established?
questions.textHi: आसियान की स्थापना किस वर्ष हुई थी?
questions.explanation: ASEAN was founded by the Bangkok Declaration, 8 August 1967. (Q145 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: आसियान की स्थापना 8 अगस्त 1967 को बैंकॉक घोषणा द्वारा हुई।

questions.text: Kanu Sanyal is associated with which movement?
questions.textHi: कानू सान्याल किस आन्दोलन से जुड़े हैं?
questions.explanation: Kanu Sanyal was a founder-leader of the Naxalbari uprising (1967). (Q147 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: कानू सान्याल नक्सलबाड़ी विद्रोह (1967) के संस्थापक नेताओं में थे।

questions.text: In which year was the National Human Rights Commission established in India?
questions.textHi: भारत में राष्ट्रीय मानवाधिकार आयोग की स्थापना किस वर्ष हुई?
questions.explanation: The NHRC was set up on 12 October 1993. (Q149 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: राष्ट्रीय मानवाधिकार आयोग की स्थापना 12 अक्टूबर 1993 को हुई।

questions.text: The Nanavati Commission is related to:
questions.textHi: नानावती आयोग सम्बन्धित है-
questions.explanation: The Nanavati Commission (2000) inquired into the 1984 anti-Sikh riots. (Q150 of the paper.) Source: https://examsuccessmaster.blogspot.com/2021/12/hp-tet-arts-nov-2021-solved-paper.html
questions.explanationHi: नानावती आयोग (2000) ने 1984 के सिख विरोधी दंगों की जाँच की।
